integrity: The mathematical proof establishes the universal lower bound and complete equality classification; standard-library enumeration independently checks all 3002 anonymous profiles with at most six voters. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three candidates, committee sizes one and two, unweighted approval ballots, full irresolute winner sets; no assertion about larger candidate sets, all house sizes, or independent priority.
title: Sharp six-voter house-nonnesting boundary for Adams approval voting
